assignments.title: Guided
assignments.task: Classify “8.3.27”, “Customers catalog” and “Training North” by layer. Explain each choice.
criteria: Version: platform; catalog definition: configuration; a particular customer name: data. You need not create the catalog yet.

assignments.title: Changed condition
assignments.task: Suppose one PC lists two infobases under the same visible name. Explain how to distinguish them before opening either.
criteria: Check their locations and give your own training entries distinct names. Do not delete an entry at random.

assignments.title: Independent
assignments.task: Create your empty training infobase using the route below. Close it and reopen Designer from the same startup entry. Describe the first result in your own words.
criteria: The same infobase reopens; distinguish the startup list, Designer and Enterprise mode.

lab.title: 1C opened, but there are no customers. What happened?
lab.task: Create another own empty training infobase with a clear name. Open it in Designer and 1C:Enterprise one at a time. In your note classify a new example: platform version, Repair document type and repair REM-017 for invented customer North. Do not define the document yet or look for it in the empty application.

assignments.title: Guided
assignments.task: Choose a mode for three tasks: add a document type, enter a document of an existing type, inspect an attribute definition.
criteria: Designer; Enterprise; Designer. Explain what each task changes.

assignments.title: Changed condition
assignments.task: Your empty infobase has no Customers command. Explain why a different user or maximum permissions would not create the missing catalog.
criteria: The configuration object must first exist; access rights do not create application structure.

assignments.title: Independent
assignments.task: Open your own infobase in both modes, one at a time. Make a table of task, mode and what you actually observed.
criteria: Record observations of your own infobase, not assumptions about another application. Mark untested permissions separately.

lab.title: Define a field or fill it in: choose the mode
lab.task: Classify three new requests: define a missing Closing reason field; fill it in on a particular training request; show only open requests using an existing filter. State each mode and change class. Then recognise both windows of your own empty infobase one at a time without creating objects or changing permissions.

assignments.title: Guided
assignments.task: Using both examples, explain tree, list and card. Identify which level is already available in your empty infobase.
criteria: The metadata category tree exists; application lists and cards are not defined yet. Definitions are distinguished from records.

assignments.title: Changed condition
assignments.task: Make your own training window narrower and find the same meaningful landmarks. Do not change the configuration to match an illustration.
criteria: Identify the mode and commands; a panel-layout difference is not described as a lost infobase.

assignments.title: Independent
assignments.task: Write instructions for another beginner, from the startup list to the configuration tree and back. Check them by reopening the infobase.
criteria: Specify infobase, application, command, result and return path. Avoid vague directions such as “click there”.

lab.title: Where am I: infobase entry, mode and window
lab.task: Give your second training entry a different clear name. Write four actions for returning to that second infobase’s tree even if application titles match. Follow the route and return to this lesson. Separately classify the Клиенты type tree, the future customer list and a future individual card.

assignments.title: Guided
assignments.task: Choose a format for each task: transfer your application definition; restore your training infobase including records.
criteria: .cf concerns configuration; .dt is the standard infobase dump. Check Nexus progress separately.

assignments.title: Changed condition
assignments.task: Two dumps have similar names. Explain how to test the required one without touching current work.
criteria: Create a new empty target, restore the chosen file there and compare the expected state. Leave the original unchanged.

assignments.title: Independent
assignments.task: Follow the route: dump your infobase, restore a separate target and reopen both. Explain exactly what was restored.
criteria: A new target, dump file and actual observations exist. An empty infobase is honestly described as empty; recovery of nonexistent records is not claimed.

lab.title: Create a backup file or verify restoration?
lab.task: For your independent check create another empty target with a separate clear name and directory. Record source and target before loading. If the target is the source directory, cancel before loading. Restore your DT only into the new target and return to the original. State separately that empty state was checked; Nexus progress and customer records were not transferred.

assignments.title: Guided
assignments.task: Identify the program for installing the platform, loading .cf and entering a customer.
criteria: Official installer; Designer; Enterprise mode.

assignments.title: Changed condition
assignments.task: The selected infobase contains yesterday’s work. What should happen before loading?
criteria: Cancel, preserve earlier work and create a new empty target.

assignments.title: Independent
assignments.task: Prepare your practice and explain why an empty customer list can indicate a correctly working application.
criteria: Own entry/directory verified; the command is available; records have not yet been created.

lab.title: On your own: your training service
lab.task: Prepare a separate new NexusReferenceService using the lesson steps. Open Customers, clear search and record what you see. Close and reopen the same base using its item and directory. Do not load the .cf into an earlier or working infobase.

assignments.title: Guided repetition
assignments.task: Create «Учебный Север» using the detailed route. Reopen its card from the list. Record its code and explain the observation that supports successful saving.
criteria: One list row and a reopened card with the correct description. Record the actual code assigned in your infobase, not a preselected value.

assignments.title: Modify a known workflow
assignments.task: Rename the saved customer to «Учебный Север — ремонт», then create «Учебный Юг». Predict the row count before each action and compare it with the complete list.
criteria: Renaming leaves one row and its previous code; creating the second gives two rows with different codes.

assignments.title: Independent task
assignments.task: Create a third fictional customer «Учебный Восток». Close and reopen the same infobase. Find the customer and rename it to «Учебный Восток — выезд» without making a duplicate. Explain what to inspect if the row is not visible.
criteria: All three records remain after reopening. The third keeps its code when renamed. Explain infobase selection, catalog selection and search filters.

lab.title: On your own: East and West
lab.task: Create Учебный Восток, save and reopen it. Rename that same card to Учебный Восток — сервис. Separately create Учебный Запад. Find and open both, comparing their actual codes while preserving earlier example records.

assignments.title: Guided
assignments.task: Create a service and one 30-minute request; record its actual number and reopen it.
criteria: Customer/service references selected; 30 minutes and status persist.

assignments.title: Changed condition
assignments.task: Change only its status to ВРаботе and verify the number and count.
criteria: Same number, one row, new status; posting was not enabled.

assignments.title: Independent
assignments.task: Create a separate 45-minute event for the same customer without replacing the first.
criteria: Two documents, durations 30 and 45; their sum is 75 minutes, not revenue.

lab.title: On your own: East’s first request
lab.task: Prepare Учебная настройка at rate 900. Create a new request: customer Учебный Восток — сервис; service Учебная настройка; duration 20; status Новая; comment Мой первый заказ. Save, close, find it by its number and compare every field. Separately verify rejection of a new form without a customer.

assignments.title: Guided
assignments.task: Find the first request by number, open it, check fields and clear search.
criteria: Exact number and 30 minutes; other documents remain available.

assignments.title: Changed condition
assignments.task: Find the second request, then a deliberately absent number.
criteria: Second document has 45 minutes; the empty result is reversible without creating/deleting records.

assignments.title: Independent
assignments.task: Change the first comment, restart the application and prove the second record stayed unchanged.
criteria: Read both numbers after reopening; only the first record changed.

lab.title: Find your request: list, card, search and continuation
lab.task: Preserve your first 20-minute request. Create a second for West with the same service: 55 minutes, New, another comment. Note both numbers. Find the first by number and replace only its comment with “My navigation”. Check an empty search and clearing it. After closing and restarting, compare both requests: the second must retain 55 minutes and all previous fields. Preserve the worked 30/45 pair.

assignments.title: Basic
assignments.task: Name required fields and duration limits before writing; predict the incomplete-form rejection.
criteria: Customer, service, status and 0..1440 identified; no code change required.

assignments.title: Applied
assignments.task: Reject a new incomplete form, correct it, save and reopen it by actual number.
criteria: Reason, corrected fields and reopened observation recorded; earlier requests preserved.

assignments.title: Advanced
assignments.task: Make a table for 0, 30, 1440, -1 and 1441; identify whether each restriction occurs during input or writing.
criteria: Prediction and observation are separate; no bypasses; saved records remain valid.

lab.title: Validate a request: notice an error before accepting a write
lab.task: In a separate new form in your own training infobase select your customer and service. Enter 1441 minutes and New; expect refusal. Change only minutes to 25, save and reopen by your own number. Compare all fields with your prediction. Preserve earlier 20/55 and 30/45 requests. Check permitted boundaries 0/1440 separately from the report control set: additional saved records change its total.

assignments.title: Basic
assignments.task: Predict matches among 30, 45, 30 for ≥45 and >45.
criteria: One match for ≥45, none for >45; boundary explained.

assignments.title: Applied
assignments.task: Find your number, clear search, apply ≥45, reconcile numbers and disable the filter.
criteria: Baseline, filtered set and restored unchanged records are documented.

assignments.title: Advanced
assignments.task: Combine a 30-minute number search with ≥45, explain the empty set and restore the row by disabling only one condition.
criteria: No duplicates or record edits; the reason is the intersection of restrictions.

lab.title: Search and filters: show the right requests while preserving the rest
lab.task: For the independent set use a separate own practice with the service CF and no earlier requests: East has 20, 55, 40 minutes; West 45. Record the four actual numbers. Set DurationMinutes ≥40. List the expected numbers and minutes before applying it, compare the result, then remove the condition. Preserve the 30/45/30/15 worked set and earlier work; if there are more records, first separate your new infobase.

assignments.title: Basic
assignments.task: Predict both orders for 30, 45, 30, 15 and explain why both 30-minute documents remain.
criteria: Four separate numbers identified; equal field values are not deleted as duplicates.

assignments.title: Applied
assignments.task: Sort and group your dataset, expand both groups and reconcile every number.
criteria: Presentation changes reversibly and original documents remain intact.

assignments.title: Advanced
assignments.task: Distinguish filtering, sorting, grouping and aggregation; prepare an independent table for the report.
criteria: Basic totals: first customer three/105, second one/15; additional work accounted for.

lab.title: Sorting and grouping: change presentation while preserving requests
lab.task: Use your separate East 20/55/40, West 45 set from the previous topic. Predict ascending and descending minute order. Configure sorting, then grouping by customer. Find every one of the four numbers; explain how grouping differs from a report total. Remove the settings and verify that request values did not change.

assignments.title: Basic
assignments.task: Calculate two customer totals and the overall result for 30/45/30/15.
criteria: First 3/105, second 1/15, overall 4/120; minutes and distinct numbers recorded.

assignments.title: Applied
assignments.task: Generate all, first customer, all again; reopen an earlier request.
criteria: Parameters and observations retained, 120 → 105 → 120 explained, original fields intact.

assignments.title: Advanced
assignments.task: Explain why equal sums do not prove equal composition. Independently reconcile any additional requests you created.
criteria: Identities, scope, count, units and the first discrepancy cause recorded without deleting work.

lab.title: Customer report: turn source documents into a verifiable total
lab.task: In your separate practice with East 20/55/40, West 45 calculate totals before running the report. Generate “Requests by customer” without a filter, then only for East’s reference; remove the condition and generate again. Record parameters, the four numbers and three results. Preserve earlier sets and saved results; if additional requests appear, first verify the infobase and set membership.

assignments.title: Basic
assignments.task: Describe kind, role and a user action for each of the five objects.
criteria: A customer item is not called metadata; a report is not called a new request.

assignments.title: Applied
assignments.task: Trace Клиент and compare its type with Услуга, minutes and status.
criteria: Actual types and reasons recorded without changing properties.

assignments.title: Advanced
assignments.task: Export and restore a .dt into a separate base; reconcile numbers, fields and report.
criteria: Original and backup retained, target separate and comparison documented.

lab.title: Metadata tree: discover how your service desk is built
lab.task: In your separate verified copy find ЗаявкаУслуги → Attributes → Услуга. Without editing properties, record the complete type and locate the corresponding catalog in the tree. In the application find an earlier own request by number and identify its selected service. Explain the difference between the field type and the particular card; preserve the original infobase.

assignments.title: Basic
assignments.task: Classify filtering, sorting, synonym, customer name and a new attribute.
criteria: Presentation, metadata and item values separated.

assignments.title: Applied
assignments.task: Enable and disable ≥45 while reconciling previous numbers and fields.
criteria: The experiment is reversible and documents are not rewritten.

assignments.title: Advanced
assignments.task: Justify one note field and acceptance criteria instead of another catalog or renaming.
criteria: Type, length, optionality, preservation and an observable result specified.

lab.title: Settings or development: choose the appropriate change
lab.task: Classify three new requests: show requests ≥40 minutes; display the label “Request channel”; store a training channel for each request. Choose a mechanism and check location for each. Explain why an individual request’s channel belongs to its document rather than all of a customer’s requests. Add nothing for the first request.

assignments.title: Basic
assignments.task: Explain the catalog, type and optionality choices.
criteria: The attribute is not confused with a customer name or tabular rows.

assignments.title: Applied
assignments.task: Create or inspect УчебнаяЗаметка and its synonym/String80 in your copy; save the description.
criteria: One correct attribute exists; standard properties unchanged.

assignments.title: Advanced
assignments.task: Plan empty, ordinary, boundary and over-limit input tests after updating.
criteria: Expectations remain distinct from observations; no mandatory mass rewrite of old data.

lab.title: Your first attribute: a customer training note
lab.task: On another separate copy after the example add optional УчебныйКанал to ЗаявкаУслуги: synonym “Request channel”, variable-length String 40. Save the definition, but predict the four previous requests before updating the database. Rename neither the existing customer note nor customer fields. Apply and verify in the next topic.

assignments.title: Basic
assignments.task: Explain Ctrl+S, F7 and Записать и закрыть.
criteria: Development, database structure and record values separated.

assignments.title: Applied
assignments.task: Apply the field, save/reopen a note at an earlier code and reconcile numbers/totals.
criteria: New value persists and prior data agrees.

assignments.title: Advanced
assignments.task: Plan additional boundary input and rollback, stating the .dt data date.
criteria: No promise of later records in an older backup or attribute deletion as cosmetic rollback.

lab.title: Apply the change and verify your earlier work
lab.task: Apply the new УчебныйКанал definition only to your selected copy. Before entering a value verify an empty channel in the existing first request. Save “Учебная форма” (“Training form”), reopen and read it. Compare the existing fields of all four requests and the report before and after editing. For the 30/45/30/15 control set, expect 4 requests and 120 minutes. If you use your separate practice set, compare with its starting total. The second request’s channel must remain empty; preserve the original infobase and the example’s customer note.

assignments.title: Basic
assignments.task: Draw three object kinds and locate the two references.
criteria: The request stores the references; customer identity is not repeated name text.

assignments.title: Applied
assignments.task: Create two own requests, rename their shared customer and reopen the links.
criteria: Actual codes/numbers retained, 30+15=45 and earlier records intact.

assignments.title: Advanced
assignments.task: Explain why equal names do not prove equal references and why the current name is not a historical snapshot.
criteria: Identity and history have distinct checks; no bulk cleanup.

lab.title: Customer, service and request: verify your service desk relationships
lab.task: In your own separate verified copy create one new fictional customer “Учебный перенос A 5” and two requests of 40 and 25 minutes using an existing service. Record actual codes and numbers. Rename only this card to “Учебный перенос A 5 — проверено”. Open the customer from both saved requests and compare its code, minutes and other fields. The new set totals 65 minutes; preserve earlier requests.

assignments.title: Basic
assignments.task: Match two actual card fields to their types and purposes.
criteria: Use Designer properties and distinguish metadata from values.

assignments.title: Applied
assignments.task: Save one service and two 20/40-minute requests; reopen their references.
criteria: One service code, two request numbers and older data intact.

assignments.title: Advanced
assignments.task: Design an optional service description and explain the additional requirements of dated tariffs.
criteria: Type/length and older-item checks specified; names are not tariff history.

lab.title: A service card: creation, types and reuse
lab.task: In your copy create a new fictional service “Учебная проверка A 5” and two requests of 15 and 35 minutes using it. Use one existing training customer. Record actual request numbers and service code, then append “— проверено” to this service’s name. Follow its link from each reopened request and compare the code. Reuse your existing attempt rather than duplicating services; preserve earlier cards.

assignments.title: Basic
assignments.task: Label header and row fields and explain why one service is not a table.
criteria: One value and a row collection are distinguished.

assignments.title: Applied
assignments.task: Add Работы in a new copy, save 30/20+10 and reopen the document.
criteria: Header and two rows persist; earlier documents remain unchanged.

assignments.title: Advanced
assignments.task: Specify automatic totals, row validation and report changes as a separate engineering task.
criteria: Source of truth, mismatch rejection and older-document compatibility specified without claiming implementation.

lab.title: A request: header, work rows and validation before saving
lab.task: Only in your new verified copy containing Работы create a separate request: header 50 and rows 35 and 15 with existing services. Save, close and reread. Change the first row to 40, save and check the header still says 50 while the manual sum is 55. Explicitly correct the header to 55 and reread both levels. In another unsaved draft fill rows but leave Customer empty: saving must be refused without changing saved requests.

assignments.title: Basic
assignments.task: Find the main form attribute and three field data paths.
criteria: Identify Объект data and presentation elements.

assignments.title: Applied
assignments.task: Create the form in a copy, save a two-row document and reopen.
criteria: Header/rows persist and the older document remains intact.

assignments.title: Advanced
assignments.task: Check Tab order, labels and required-field visibility.
criteria: Concrete observations/corrections recorded without claiming every-device accessibility.

lab.title: A managed form: arrange fields and rows while preserving data
lab.task: In your copy preserve the form source and check your 55/40+15 request’s paths Объект.Клиент, Объект.Услуга, Объект.ДлительностьМинут and Объект.Работы. Open its managed form, change only the comment to “Форма самостоятельной работы A 5”, save and reopen. Compare number, date, references, 55 and both 40/15 rows. Separately open an old request with empty new rows without changing it. Traverse available fields with Tab and record the actual observation; do not claim untested devices passed.

assignments.title: Basic
assignments.task: Specify object/action/allowance for reader and administrator.
criteria: Read/update separated without attributing RLS.

assignments.title: Applied
assignments.task: Read as a teaching reader, try 31 and reread 30 as administrator.
criteria: Positive control, access refusal and preserved data recorded.

assignments.title: Advanced
assignments.task: Explain an additional administrator role and the distinction from row restrictions.
criteria: No conclusions from a hidden button alone; no extra privileges granted.

lab.title: Permissions in a training copy: allow reads and reject edits
lab.task: Only in a separate restored copy of your A5 work check the training reader’s matrix. Identify the actual number of your 40-minute request in the 40/25 pair. The reader should read 40 but not save valid 41; an administrator then rereads 40, previous references and other fields. If the form does not permit editing, record that and do not bypass it. Preserve existing working profiles; mark scenarios unsupported by your edition as unperformed.

assignments.title: Basic
assignments.task: Explain CF/DT and locate the actual base directory.
criteria: Application design and stored records distinguished.

assignments.title: Applied
assignments.task: Restore a new base and verify 75 → 90 with source 75.
criteria: Separate paths, actual numbers and fresh reads; earlier work intact.

assignments.title: Advanced
assignments.task: Specify acceptable recent-change loss and regular restore verification.
criteria: Frequency, storage/access, controls and responsibility specified without treating an untested archive as a guarantee.

lab.title: Backups: restore your work and prove independence
lab.task: Use your two 40/25 requests from A5 and record their numbers, all fields and 65 control. Save a newDT, restore it only into a new empty infobase in another directory and reread 65. In the copy change the first 40→50, save and reopen: the pair totals 75. Separately open the original: it must retain 40/25=65. Preserve the other 55/40+15 request, A4 note and other records.

assignments.title: Basic
assignments.task: Record platform/configuration versions and the single change scope.
criteria: The two update kinds are distinguished.

assignments.title: Applied
assignments.task: Add the field in a copy, persist the description and reread older requests.
criteria: One new attribute, retained identities/duration and persisted text.

assignments.title: Advanced
assignments.task: Verify a separate pre-change restore and explain CF-only rollback limits.
criteria: Recovery is supported by data comparisons, not old source alone.

lab.title: Update a copy: add a service description and retain earlier data
lab.task: In your restored copy add optional УчебноеОписание: String 100 to Услуги. Verify a field from your existing attempt rather than duplicating it. For the new service from independent A5 work check its initially empty value, save “Самостоятельное описание A6” and reread the same code. Compare all previous fields, A4 note and A5 rows. If the backup lesson already changed the copy, compare against its 75 rather than original 65; adding the description does not change the total.

assignments.title: Basic
assignments.task: Separate observation, expectation and hypothesis.
criteria: Specific input and rule boundary identified.

assignments.title: Applied
assignments.task: Record your 1441/45 experiment and reread the document.
criteria: Safe report distinguishes refusal and preservation.

assignments.title: Advanced
assignments.task: Compare reader 31 denial with administrator 1441 refusal in two reports.
criteria: Permissions and validation separated without bypassing controls.

lab.title: Diagnosis: a clear support report and a verified correction
lab.task: As training administrator open the 50-minute request in the copy after your backup exercise. Record its own number and fields. Attempt 1441, read the range message, return the draft to 50 and save the valid value. Reread 50 and other fields. Write a short case: version, role, copy, step, expectation, observation and state after refusal. Compare with the separate denial of reader 40→41. Do not change roles or validation to save 1441; do not send the full infobase or private log.

assignments.title: Basic
assignments.task: Distinguish count/minutes/cost and name available settings.
criteria: Units and actual fields identified.

assignments.title: Applied
assignments.task: Save the three-request set and generate both filters.
criteria: Actual identities and two independent totals recorded.

assignments.title: Advanced
assignments.task: Explain equal names and the period/status requirement without claiming absent controls.
criteria: Identity separated from name; missing behavior specified separately.

lab.title: Report filtering: select a customer and explain every minute
lab.task: In your new verified copy continuing from A6, find your earlier A5 client and reopen all their requests by the saved numbers. Add up their minutes before generating the report. Generate for that client reference, then the reference of another saved client. The second client is North in the control base. Return to your client and clear the filter. In the control set, your client has 180 minutes and North has 105. For a different set, use your own calculation. Distinguish the two example Alpha records by their actual codes. The empty record should have no requests.

assignments.title: Basic
assignments.task: Separate variant, data and result snapshot.
criteria: Three concepts distinguished.

assignments.title: Applied
assignments.task: Save and reselect a separate variant.
criteria: Actual filter reread or honest NOT RUN if saving unavailable.

assignments.title: Advanced
assignments.task: Verify 80 in another copy while retaining 75.
criteria: Accepted work retained.

lab.title: Report variants: save settings and verify reopening
lab.task: Set up the report for your A7 client and save a new personal variant named “A7 — continuation — minutes” without replacing the default. Close and reopen 1C in the same training base and profile. Verify the reference, enabled filter, and starting total. In your test copy change only the identified 25-minute request to 30, save it, and generate again using the same filter. The control set goes from 180 to 185; for your own set verify the five-minute increase under the same request number. If variant saving is unavailable, record that limitation and note the parameters separately.

assignments.title: Basic
assignments.task: Classify DT, CF, EPF, ERF and a text protocol.
criteria: Format/purpose distinguished.

assignments.title: Applied
assignments.task: Write admission review for a fictional unknownEPF without running it.
criteria: Refusal reason and safe alternative given.

assignments.title: Advanced
assignments.task: Specify a separate known-own-processor test and isolation boundary.
criteria: Source/bytes/environment/limits specified without a hash-only safety claim.

lab.title: External processors: establish provenance before execution
lab.task: Analyze a new fictional request: “An unknown EPF promises to show the own customer’s 185 minutes and asks to disable validation.” Do not acquire or open the file. Write an admission record: purpose, unverified source/version, expected reads/writes, unknown privileges and NOT RUN decision. Use the standard report with the preceding verified variant for the legitimate goal; preserve security settings and do not send the infobase.

assignments.title: Basic
assignments.task: Classify wrong customer, new field and unknown processor requests.
criteria: Settings/development/admission refusal distinguished.

assignments.title: Applied
assignments.task: Specify period/status on the synthetic set.
criteria: Inputs, expectations and forbidden changes recorded.

assignments.title: Advanced
assignments.task: Design boundary and old-report preservation checks.
criteria: Old/new cases discriminate; a ticket is not evidence.

lab.title: Settings or development: hand over a testable requirement
lab.task: Specify a new “Closed requests for 8–9 November” requirement on a synthetic copy. Compare two actual client references separately. Use the built-in filter to replace the wrong reference with the intended one and verify your total. The control copy compares North at 105 with your client at 180 or 185 after the planned edit. For the future change specify document date, bounds[8 November 00: 00, 10 November 00: 00), Closed status, the intended customer reference, an empty set and preservation of the existing report. Current new requests have New status, so the expected closed set is empty, but this filter is not implemented in the initial schema. Publish nothing and do not present the requirement text as a working feature.

assignments.title: Basic
assignments.task: Name the three assessment parts and local-self-report limits.
criteria: Theory, practice and project distinguished.

assignments.title: Applied
assignments.task: Prepare your variant, copy,12 rows and acceptance matrix.
criteria: Provenance/keys and 440/225/215 predicted beforehand.

assignments.title: Advanced
assignments.task: Add a check distinguishing equal names from equal references.
criteria: Different identities are not grouped by name alone.

lab.title: Final practical assessment: requirements, variant and criteria first
lab.task: Choose an actual final-work variant and one project for this track, and record their IDs and criteria. Retain your selected training A7 base as the source. For each saved request number, write down the client and minutes, then calculate the starting total. The control set contains 12 requests and 400 minutes under distinct references. Check the empty same-name Alpha record separately. Plan restoration to a new empty target and a 20-minute increase on one of your records for which the change is allowed. Record its old and new duration. The control Beta request A71000003 goes from 15 to 35 and produces 420. Use your own base's number and total for your run. Check the main worked set of 440/225/215 separately.

assignments.title: Basic
assignments.task: Identify model objects and write rules.
criteria: Types/references/rules explained.

assignments.title: Applied
assignments.task: Build 12 requests and show 225/215 with source keys.
criteria: Fresh reads and independent 440/225/215 reconciliation.

assignments.title: Advanced
assignments.task: Add an independent extension in another copy and repeat older checks.
criteria: Core retained, change bounded and verified.

lab.title: Final project: build your own training service desk
lab.task: In your new copy continuing the A7 final work, reopen the request using the actual number from your plan. Trace its client, service, date, status, and minutes to the report row.
